title: Does the 'larger models are more steerable' finding hold for safety concepts specifically?

original_idea.body: Extract concept vectors across 3-4 sizes of an open family for ~5 safety and ~5 benign concepts; measure steering gain vs size and test whether safety-concept slopes differ from benign.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: dual-use scaling map of safety-concept steerability informs misuse risk.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: CAA gain curves across one family of 3-4 sizes; guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused but 10 concepts x 4 sizes is a bit broad.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Dual-use mapping on open models, weak lab incentive.

novelty.reasoning: Scaling claim exists; safety-vs-benign slope comparison may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: The safety-specific slope test may be open.
